resources.string: no error was given; its log is in logcat (python.stderr).
DeepSeek API key, for the router and every worker. Sent as Authorization: Bearer <key> to api.deepseek.com.
Fly Sprites org token. Workers run on Sprites; sent as Authorization: Bearer <token> to api.sprites.dev.
Sync server URL, when it is not the public relay (https://orchestrate-sync.nandithebull.workers.dev).
Sync space key, copied from another computer\'s Settings to share its projects. Sent as X-Sync-Space: <key> to the sync server.
OpenGateway API key, for projects on deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-ultrafast. Sent as Authorization: Bearer <key> to https://apis.opengateway.ai/v1.
GitHub fine-grained token with Contents: Read and write on the project repos, for projects with a GitHub remote. Workers never get it.
